rationale: Reconcile Adobe FY2025 GAAP and adjusted operating performance before using next-year ARR guidance. Include each disclosed quarterly comparison, quantify the annual change in the adjustment gap by component, and show why growth rates differ. Build an ARR basis bridge from observed FY2025 exit to revalued FY2026 opening and the mechanically implied target on the disclosed growth basis. Keep forecasts and ARR stock measures distinct from recognized revenue.

construction_revision.maintenance_rationale: An analyst can misattribute better GAAP growth to recurring performance when a prior acquisition expense leaves the adjusted measure. ARR guidance requires another basis reconciliation, and a currency-driven revaluation does not identify organic sales or recognized revenue.

The adjusted_operating_income_usd_million column retains independently reported non-GAAP operating income. Adjustments sum the signed adjustment rows. Residual is GAAP plus those adjustments less reported non-GAAP operating income.
